title: MessageProvenanceReport v1 — the provenance gate's whole standing at a moment: the policy it runs under, every enrolled node with the fingerprint of the key its certificate binds and whether the gate holds that node's keypair and can sign for it, every admission record in the order messages reached the door, and the counted totals — messages seen, verified, and dropped, with drops counted apart by their named reasons; simulated is a constant — the cryptography is real Ed25519 (Y-011) but the gate is an in-process door and no LAN was crossed (Y-059)
